title: Find The Duplicate Number
prompt: Given an array of integers nums containing n + 1 integers where each integer is in the range [1, n] inclusive. There is only one repeated number in nums, return this repeated number. You must solve the problem without modifying the array and using only constant extra space.
hints: Treat array as linked list: index i points to nums[i]. The duplicate creates a cycle. Use Floyd's cycle detection.
Phase 1: Find meeting point of slow and fast. Phase 2: Start one from 0, one from meeting point; both move 1. They meet at the duplicate.
Why: the duplicate is the entrance to the cycle. Floyd's algorithm finds it.
